_generation_notes.scope: Generated against the attached prompt. The named master spec and production scorer were not supplied or inspected.
_generation_notes.synthetic_scope: Every entity, timestamp, count, incident, evidence statement, factor annotation, label, and rho value is planted synthetic sample data. Evidence counts are not customer measurements.
_generation_notes.construction_method: Authored incident mechanisms and action-specific recovery conditions, then selected two-decimal numeric witnesses using seeded rejection sampling against the reference centroids and all proper enrichment subsets. This selection deliberately plants successful crossings and is not a performance evaluation. Block B rho tags are mixed across both templates and both target actions.

reference_scoring.prediction: Unique minimum squared distance; no distance ties occur at surface or full enrichment.
reference_scoring.weights: All six factors have weight 1. No learned weights, covariance, priors, softmax temperature, or runtime thresholds are assumed.
reference_scoring.centroid_source: Midpoints of the action-profile ranges in the supplied prompt.
reference_scoring.factor_interpretation: Factor values are planted unit-interval annotations, not measured proportions. source_reliability concerns the immediate source product consumed by this pipeline; a derived source may be unreliable even when its raw inputs are intact. Unread factors retain their cached surface estimates.
reference_scoring.impact_interpretation: impact_scope tracks downstream breadth. Criticality and recovery authority appear separately in operational evidence and never substitute for fan-out.

specification_resolutions.issue: A general variation rule asks v1-v3 to have different actions, but Templates 1-4 fix one action and Templates 5-6 permit at most two.
specification_resolutions.resolution: Preserve each template-specific action constraint. Vary root causes, source contracts, recovery conditions, evidence, numeric vectors, and rho. Do not invent three distinct actions where the template prohibits them.

specification_resolutions.issue: Template 4 specifies only impact_scope, while the global boundary rule requires at least two large shifts.
specification_resolutions.resolution: Add distinct pattern-familiarity and transformation-health evidence. Its three required hops each shift at least 0.30, with impact shifting at least 0.60.

specification_resolutions.issue: Several template summaries do not by themselves move the supplied centroid geometry to the prescribed action.
specification_resolutions.resolution: Add relevant distinct-factor hops until the intended action is the unique nearest centroid. Verify that every proper subset still misses that action, so extra hops are not decorative.

specification_resolutions.issue: Block B permits shifts of at least 0.15 while the global non-control rule demands two shifts of at least 0.30.
specification_resolutions.resolution: Satisfy both numerical lower bounds with two shifts of 0.30-0.36. Moderate cases have low assigned rho and a small final squared-distance winning margin of 0.002-0.018. They are not claimed to have empirically ambiguous labels or calibrated posterior probabilities.

specification_resolutions.issue: The prompt associates rho=0.50 with VLD accuracy of exactly 1/5.
specification_resolutions.resolution: Keep five nonflat rho=0.50 instrument fixtures and balance their planted labels one per action. Do not claim a chance-accuracy result: rho has no supplied generative definition, and routing-signal correctness is not action accuracy.
specification_resolutions.mathematical_limit: A uniform random five-action guess has expected accuracy 0.20 for any fixed label. A binary signal that is correct with probability 0.50 under a symmetric independent noise construction does not imply that a multi-step investigator with other evidence has 0.20 accuracy.
specification_resolutions.instrument_role: These records check serialization, nonflat reads, action coverage, budget enforcement, and rho handling. They are not a validated information-null benchmark.
specification_resolutions.required_for_a_null_test: Define a stochastic hint generator and randomized action assignments such that the entire permitted observation history is independent of the hidden action under the null; evaluate repeated held-out draws against a specified action prior. Do not assert exact 20% from five deterministic fixtures.

specification_resolutions.issue: rho_planted is provided as metadata without a routing-signal or noise model.
specification_resolutions.resolution: Preserve the exact requested block distributions as assigned fixture parameters. No realized informativeness, intervention success rate, or VLD advantage is inferred from these tags.

specification_resolutions.issue: A static full oracle JSON is not itself an implemented graph-retrieval experiment.
specification_resolutions.resolution: Include explicit graph-query paths, alert-time evidence records, and prerequisite branch IDs as optional extensions. A harness must enforce those extensions for sequential discovery. Without enforcement, the file remains a minimal multi-read boundary-crossing fixture, not proof of conditional routing value.

specification_resolutions.issue: One read may return several graph neighbors.
specification_resolutions.resolution: Each unit read is one bounded source query, including its returned fan-out set. It is not one edge, one database round trip in a deployed system, or one millisecond of execution.

evaluation_contract.oracle_only: The complete file is an evaluator fixture. Do not pass it wholesale to the tested policy or LLM.
initial_policy_view: branch cards containing only branch_id, evidence_source, read_cost, and factor_enriched
evaluation_contract.read_protocol: Start with the pipeline node known. A branch is eligible only when its prerequisite branch IDs have been read and its query start node is known. The harness exposes eligible branch cards without answer labels, charges the read_cost, returns that branch evidence and numeric update, and reveals its result nodes/edges. Failed or repeated reads must not be free; cache policy and rejected-read charging must be fixed across methods.
evaluation_contract.factor_update_rule: A selected branch sets exactly its factor_enriched to factor_new_value. Required hops enrich distinct factors. Historical distractors preserve the corresponding surface estimate; within-budget distractor substitutions cannot reach the planted action.
evaluation_contract.stopping_and_scoring: After spending at most budget, compare the selected action to the hidden ground_truth_action. Surface and centroid-enrichment oracle checks are fixture validation only; runtime policy performance requires a separate measured run.
evaluation_contract.leakage_limits: Generic branch and node IDs are permuted per case. Template, source-name, and semantic cue leakage are not proven absent; hold out whole template families and avoid presenting oracle descriptions or labels when testing generalization.
baseline_requirements: random eligible branch selection under the same budget
adaptive retrieval with the same evidence interface
evaluation_contract.real_world_claims: No measurement of VLD value, native graph traversal, runtime accuracy, latency, rho calibration, or customer recovery outcomes is made.
